skill.name: Egg Bomb
skill.desc: Throws 6 exploding eggs at the tightest enemy clusters.

skill.name: Amnesia
skill.desc: Goes blank for a second, then covers itself with a big shield. When it breaks or after 4s, part of the absorbed damage hits adjacent enemies.

skill.name: Teleport
skill.desc: Teleports away from whoever is hitting it while keeping its target in range (if there is no room, it stays) and its next 2 attacks carry a psychic strike.

skill.name: Lovely Kiss
skill.desc: Blows a kiss at its target and puts it to sleep.

skill.name: Swift
skill.desc: Fires a burst of never-missing stars at its target (if it falls, the rest go to the enemy closest to it).

skill.name: Outrage
skill.desc: Flies into a rage: two dragon blows to every enemy around it (the second makes them flinch). Afterwards it is confused for 1s.

skill.name: Growth
skill.desc: The mushroom grows: each time it uses this it gains 12% Attack and 5% lifesteal until the end of combat. Every 3 uses it releases spores that put adjacent enemies to sleep for 1.5s.

skill.name: Dig
skill.desc: Burrows, spends 1s underground where nothing can reach it, then its three heads pop up under its target: three headbutts that can be critical hits; the third knocks it airborne.

skill.name: Blizzard
skill.desc: Snow falls on the whole field: damages and slows everyone, and freezes those left with low HP.

skill.name: Earthquake
skill.desc: Shakes the whole board: damages every enemy (except Flying types) and slightly hurts adjacent allies.

skill.name: Thunder
skill.desc: 3 lightning bolts strike where enemies are densest (5 in Rain), damaging and paralyzing those around each one.

skill.name: Surf
skill.desc: A wave sweeps the two foremost enemy rows: damages them and pushes them back.

skill.name: Soft-Boiled
